files.description: 54-page PDF documenting Lunar's EHI export format. Contains C-CDA section specifications (18 sections) with XML examples, key element tables, and supplemental CSV data dictionary (documents, orders, charges). This is the primary and sole documentation artifact.
Raw HTML of the EHI export page. Webflow-hosted page containing a single iframe that embeds the PDF from the CDN. No other content or links.
Browser screenshot of the EHI export page showing the embedded PDF viewer.
Bun TypeScript script that extracts structured data from the EHI Export PDF via pdftotext. Parses all 18 C-CDA sections and 3 supplemental CSV categories into queryable JSON.
Extracted JSON containing document metadata and all 18 C-CDA sections with descriptions, template IDs, LOINC codes, and 146 key element definitions.
Extracted JSON containing 3 supplemental CSV data dictionary categories (Documents: 12 fields, Orders: 14 fields, Charges: 16 fields) with field names, descriptions, and data types.
Parse accounting output: 54 pages processed, 18/18 sections found, 3 supplemental categories, 42 supplemental fields, 146 key elements, 0 parse failures.
Documentation for the enrichment scripts: run commands, input boundary, output files, known parsing limitations.
